**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement restriction on us. Beyond the absence of any such covenant, § 12.3 affirmatively protects our position by preserving our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and recording that we have made no no-hire commitment. This meets the playbook's preferred position, so no change is required.
